title.ko: seem · appear · tend to · probably · a bit · I was wondering if
title.en: seem · appear · tend to · probably · a bit · I was wondering if

explain.ko: 완곡 표현(hedging)은 의견이나 사실을 덜 단정적으로 말해 정중하고 정확하게 만드는 방법입니다. seem, appear, tend to는 일반적인 경향을, probably, may well, might는 가능성의 정도를, a bit, somewhat, rather는 정도를 부드럽게 만듭니다. 학술적인 글에서는 research suggests, it appears that처럼 쓰고, 대화에서는 I was wondering if …, Would it be possible to …, It might be worth …처럼 씁니다. 확신이 없을 때나 상대에게 반대하거나 부탁할 때 특히 유용합니다. 너무 많이 쓰면 의견이 불분명해지므로 균형이 필요합니다.
explain.en: Hedging makes statements less absolute, which is both polite and accurate. Seem, appear and tend to show general tendency; probably, may well and might show degree of likelihood; a bit, somewhat and rather soften degree. In academic writing use research suggests and it appears that; in conversation use I was wondering if …, Would it be possible to …, It might be worth …. It is useful when you are unsure, disagree, or ask a favour. Overuse makes your view unclear, so keep a balance.

notes.en: I was wondering if uses the past continuous to make a present request polite.

notes.en: A bit softens negative adjectives: a bit slow.

notes.en: Academic writing prefers suggest and indicate to definite statements.
